title: PRD-21 synthetic risk input syntax

liabilityClassCode.description: required; approved professional/public/employer classification <= 80. Sensitivity: internal. Error: LIABILITY_CLASS_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

insuredPartyRef.description: required; authorized person or legal entity. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: INSURED_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

operationsDescription.description: required; 1–2000 NFC characters. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: OPERATIONS_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

exposureMeasures.description: required by class; only versioned named nonnegative decimal measures. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: EXPOSURE_SCHEMA_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

locationRefs.description: conditional by class; 1–100 permitted locations. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: LOCATION_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

limitOption.description: required; approved occurrence/aggregate structure. Sensitivity: financial. Error: LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

priorClaimsRef.description: conditional by underwriting; restricted declaration version. Sensitivity: highly restricted. Error: CLAIM_HISTORY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
